consistency.instructions: Classify whether the supplied normalized record is semantically consistent after exact schema and invariant checks. Use only supplied evidence: do not infer completion, health, approval or other missing state. If sources are tentative, materially mixed, or required semantic evidence is absent and structured fields do not resolve it, select unclear.

criteria.consistent: All supplied structured fields and semantic text support one materially coherent state. No material source conflict or unresolved tentative claim remains, and no missing semantic evidence is being inferred.
criteria.inconsistent: Two or more supplied fields/sources assert materially incompatible states that require interpreting their meaning.
criteria.unclear: Evidence is materially sparse, tentative or mixed and the supplied structured fields do not resolve the uncertainty well enough to call the record consistent or inconsistent.

state.semanticSummary: The deployment finished successfully and the post-deploy health checks passed.
